sec-head.h2: Vector embedding vs text vs token
sec-head.p: These are fundamentally different representations: a vector is a mathematical object, text is human-readable, and a token is a processing unit.
Each layer of a production embedding pipeline, built and tested as its own verifiable stage.

card.p: Building the pipeline that cleans, normalizes, and splits your source text into optimally sized chunks for embedding generation, directly affecting retrieval quality.
Selecting and configuring the right embedding model (OpenAI, Cohere, sentence-transformers, BGE) based on your domain, latency, and dimensionality requirements.
Designing the vector storage layer (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, pgvector) for efficient indexing, approximate nearest neighbor search, and scalable retrieval.
Implementing cosine similarity, dot product, or Euclidean distance search with metadata filtering and hybrid search to maximize relevance of retrieved embeddings.
Testing retrieval precision, recall, and mean reciprocal rank against your real queries using a customized evaluation set, with results shared transparently before launch.
Deploying the full embedding pipeline as a versioned, monitored API integrated with your application or search system.
